Summary: Advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price payable in two equal instalments at 8% simple interest per annum.
Quote:
The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to
10% (ten per cent)7 of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition
of equipment.
Notes: The advance carries simple interest at 8% per annum and is paid in two equal instalments against bank guarantees of 110% of each instalment. In the event of termination for Contractor Default, interest is deemed to be 3% above the Bank Rate (Clause 17.2.6). Annex-III on page 160 references an interest-free advance of 10% in three instalments under Clause 19.2.
